"One event of the push of 'checkout': the instance's whole snapshot with its revision, in the types its get answers, or the end of the stream."
type CheckoutMachineChange {
  "The incarnation of the instance the stream follows."
  rowId: Long @cost(weight: "10")
  "The snapshot's revision. Drop an event at or below the revision you hold: each is whole, so a skipped revision loses nothing."
  revision: Long @cost(weight: "10")
  "The state the instance is in, or null on an event that carries no snapshot."
  state: CheckoutMachineState @cost(weight: "10")
  "The instance's context, as get answers it, or null on an event that carries no snapshot."
  context: CheckoutMachineContext @cost(weight: "10")
  "When the timer of the state the instance is in fires, or null."
  dueAt: DateTime @cost(weight: "10")
  "Whether dueAt can be trusted. A push is the row as it is now, so it always can; the field is here so a push and a get decode with one type."
  dueAtKnown: Boolean! @cost(weight: "10")
  "The instance was deleted or expired. The last event of the stream."
  gone: Boolean! @cost(weight: "10")
  "Read the instance again: this event does not stand for it. A skipped revision never sets it."
  reload: Boolean! @cost(weight: "10")
  "Why the stream was refused or ended, or null. The last event of the stream."
  problem: SnapshotProblem @cost(weight: "10")
}

"The context of an instance of 'checkout': every field any of its states declares, null where the state the instance is in does not hold it."
type CheckoutMachineContext {
  lines: [CartLine] @cost(weight: "10")
  address: String @cost(weight: "10")
  paymentToken: String @cost(weight: "10")
  orderId: UUID @cost(weight: "10")
  parcelId: UUID @cost(weight: "10")
}

"An instance of 'checkout' as the server stored it, or the problem the operation was refused with."
type CheckoutMachineResult {
  "The instance's id."
  id: UUID @cost(weight: "10")
  "The instance's revision, bumped by every write. It travels beside the snapshot, never in it."
  revision: Long @cost(weight: "10")
  state: CheckoutMachineState @cost(weight: "10")
  context: CheckoutMachineContext @cost(weight: "10")
  "When the timer of the state the instance is in fires, or null when that state has no timer or the server cleared it. Says nothing when dueAtKnown is false."
  dueAt: DateTime @cost(weight: "10")
  "False when the answer replays a request the instance has moved past since: the server cannot know that state's due time, so dueAt is null and means nothing. Treat dueAt as absent then."
  dueAtKnown: Boolean! @cost(weight: "10")
  "Why the operation was refused, or null when it was not."
  problem: SnapshotProblem @cost(weight: "10")
  "The run this instance's current state queued, while it sits in that state; null otherwise. Only the instance's owner sees it."
  invokedRun: MachineInvokedRun @cost(weight: "10")
}

"""
What kind of failure a train hit, so a consumer can decide whether to retry, rebase, or give up
without matching on exception messages at every call site.
"""
enum FailureClass {
  """
  No classifier was registered, or it did not recognise this failure. Means "decide as you
  would have before this existed": the default, so behaviour is unchanged until something
  deliberately acts on a classification.
  """
  UNCLASSIFIED
  """
  Expected to succeed if attempted again: a throttle, a lost connection, a server timeout
  reported as an error.
  """
  TRANSIENT
  """
  Someone else changed the thing first. The work is valid but was built on a state that has
  moved, so the answer is usually to rebuild against current state and try again, not to
  compensate.
  """
  CONFLICT
  """
  Will fail the same way every time: a validation error, a missing record, a rejected
  credential. Retrying is waste.
  """
  PERMANENT
}

"""
What one step of a run's timeline is: a junction that ran, a question a routing step asked, or
the track a routing step took. Carried by junction events and stored in
trax.junction_run.kind.
"""
enum JunctionRunKind {
  "An EffectJunction that ran."
  JUNCTION
  "A question answered by choosing one of its options (Decide, Switch)."
  CHOICE
  "A question answered by a position on ordered levels (Scale)."
  SCORE
  "A question answered by the probability of yes (Gate)."
  YES_NO
  "The track a routing step sent the run down."
  ROUTE
}

"""
Where one step of a run's timeline stands. Carried by junction events and stored in
trax.junction_run.state.
"""
enum JunctionRunState {
  "The junction has started and not yet returned."
  IN_PROGRESS
  "The junction returned a result, or the question was answered, or the track taken."
  COMPLETED
  "The junction failed, or a decider's answer was refused and the routing step failed on it."
  FAILED
  "The junction stopped because the run was asked to cancel."
  CANCELLED
}

"""
One step of a run: a junction that ran, a question a routing step asked, or the track it took.
The onJunctionEvent subscription carries one per event, and
operations.junctionRuns returns a run's steps as AddJunctionEvents() recorded them.
"""
type JunctionStep {
  "Where the step falls in the run, from 0. A junction's start and end share it."
  position: Int!
  "What the step is."
  kind: JunctionRunKind!
  "The junction's class name without its namespace, or a question's key."
  name: String!
  "Where the step stands."
  state: JunctionRunState!
  "When the junction started, or when the question was answered or the track taken (UTC)."
  startedAt: DateTime!
  "When the junction returned (UTC), or null while it runs."
  endedAt: DateTime
  "Milliseconds from StartedAt to EndedAt, or null while it runs."
  durationMs: Float
  "How a failed junction's failure is classified; null unless it failed."
  failureClass: FailureClass
  "The type name of the exception a junction failed or was cancelled with, never its message."
  failureException: String
  "The question's key, for a question or a track."
  questionKey: String
  "The answer the run acted on, or null for a junction, a refused answer and a withheld one."
  answer: String
  "How sure the decider was, for a choice or a score; null when withheld."
  confidence: Float
  "True when the answer came from an earlier run rather than a decider."
  replayed: Boolean!
  "The full name of the decider's type. Live events only; the recorded timeline does not keep it."
  decider: String
  "True when the question is about a [TraxSensitive] type, so its answer and confidence are absent."
  answerWithheld: Boolean!
  "Which attempt of its manifest the run is, or null for a run with no manifest."
  attempt: Int
  """
  True when Name is (withheld): the step is on a decision track, and its
  name would give away an answer this caller is not shown.
  """
  nameWithheld: Boolean!
  """
  The position of the latest routing step before this one, or null before any. Every step
  after a route, a junction, a question or a further route, counts as on its track.
  """
  trackPosition: Int
  "The id of the declared node this step ran for, as operations.runGraph names it. Null for a step recorded before node ids were, and wherever the step's name is withheld, since the id names the track."
  nodeId: String
  "The path of the Parallel branch the step ran in, such as Parallel#0/cocitation, or null outside any branch. Withheld wherever the step's name is."
  branchPath: String
}

"""
Every code a machine operation is refused with, by the engine, the draft service, the effect runner or the API. It
is one closed set: the engines' corpora, the GraphQL RefusalCode enum and the TypeScript package's
RefusalCode all hold these members, and each travels as its RefusalCode) spelling,
such as GUARD_FAILED.
"""
enum RefusalCode {
  "No transition is wired from the current state on the given trigger (or the state/trigger token is unknown)."
  NO_TRANSITION
  "A transition exists but its guard rejected the supplied input."
  GUARD_FAILED
  """
  A context fails its state's validator: produced by a transition (a reducer bug), or found in a stored or
  submitted snapshot.
  """
  INVALID_CONTEXT
  "An unexpected error was caught inside the engine. Surfaced as a refusal so the caller never sees an exception."
  INTERNAL_ERROR
  "The trigger input does not match the trigger's declared input schema."
  INVALID_INPUT
  "The trigger is an invoked train's outcome, which only the outcome path applies, never an advance."
  OUTCOME_BOUND
  "The trigger is a state's timer, which only the server fires, never an advance."
  TIMER_BOUND
  "The trigger input or the resulting snapshot is past the snapshot size cap."
  TOO_LARGE
  """
  A refusal of discard: the instance is in a state only the server puts it in (a committed state, an
  effect's target, a state that invokes a train, a state an invoked train's outcome reaches, or the target of an
  event gated by a role or a policy), or an effect on it is running or recording its result.
  """
  DISCARD_NOT_ALLOWED
  """
  An effect is pending on the instance: every other write to it waits until the effect is recorded or has
  failed. Retry once it has finished.
  """
  EFFECT_IN_PROGRESS
  "Stored or submitted JSON was not valid JSON, was not an object, or was missing a required field."
  MALFORMED
  "The snapshot or the request names a machine this host does not serve."
  UNKNOWN_MACHINE
  "The snapshot was produced against a different definition version."
  VERSION_MISMATCH
  "The snapshot's state token is not a state of this machine."
  UNKNOWN_STATE
  "The caller does not meet the rule the event, start or read declares."
  FORBIDDEN
  "The request id was already used for a different request."
  REQUEST_ID_REUSED
  "The trigger runs the machine's irreversible effect from this state, so only a send fires it, never an advance."
  EFFECT_BOUND
  "A save is not allowed for this machine, because its states are reached through declared events only."
  SAVE_NOT_ALLOWED
  "The client runs an older version of the machine than the server, and must reload."
  CLIENT_OUTDATED
  "The client runs a newer version of the machine than this server; a retry may reach a newer one."
  SERVER_OUTDATED
  "The user already holds as many drafts as one user may, so a start or a save creating another is refused."
  TOO_MANY_DRAFTS
  "The request id is missing, empty, whitespace, too long, or holds a character a row cannot store."
  INVALID_REQUEST_ID
  "The caller names no user, so there is no owner to act for."
  UNAUTHENTICATED
  "The machine declares no start, so a client cannot create an instance of it."
  NO_START
  "The instance belongs to the system: only host code creates, drives or deletes it."
  SYSTEM_OWNED
  """
  The caller has no instance with this id that it may read: a missing id, another user's, a system instance's,
  and one the read rule refuses the caller all get this one answer, so it tells the caller nothing about which.
  """
  NOT_FOUND
  "The caller already holds as many open subscriptions as one principal may; one that completes frees its place."
  TOO_MANY_SUBSCRIPTIONS
  "The client sent a twin's IR hash that differs from the machine this host serves; it must reload."
  SCHEMA_MISMATCH
  "The draft changed elsewhere while this write ran; reload and retry."
  CONFLICT
  "The machine declares no irreversible effect, so there is nothing to send."
  NO_EFFECT
  "The effect, or the store around it, failed: the draft was not advanced, so the caller can retry."
  DELIVERY_FAILED
  "The snapshot a client computed differs from the one the server computed for the same transition."
  CLIENT_DIVERGENCE
  "The state is completed by its action, not by a save: a client sends the action instead."
  STATE_RESERVED
  "The instance is in a state that invokes a train: it moves on when the train finishes, or through one of its actions, never through a save."
  DRAFT_INVOKING
  "The stored draft cannot be read by this machine definition, so only a start-over overwrites it."
  DRAFT_UNREADABLE
  "The draft was already completed, so an edit may not overwrite it."
  DRAFT_COMMITTED
  "The draft's action already ran on content that has changed since; its result is recorded only once that content is restored."
  DRAFT_CHANGED
  "The owner already has as many invoked runs live as one owner may, so the step that starts another is refused."
  INVOKE_LIMIT_REACHED
  "The user entering the state may not run the train it invokes."
  INVOKE_FORBIDDEN
  """
  An outcome or a timer would enter a state that invokes a train on a user-owned instance: only a system-owned
  instance chains runs that way.
  """
  INVOKE_CHAIN_USER_OWNED
}

"A run as its starter reads it."
type RunProgress {
  runId: String! @cost(weight: "10")
  "The train's field, as the schema serves it; null for a train the schema does not expose."
  train: String @cost(weight: "10")
  state: RunProgressState @cost(weight: "10")
  "The steps recorded so far, in order, at most 500."
  steps: [JunctionStep!]! @cost(weight: "10")
  "Why the run failed, when a junction threw a TrainException."
  failure: String @cost(weight: "10")
  problem: SnapshotProblem @cost(weight: "10")
  "The id of the run that retries this failed one, once it is queued: follow that run next."
  retriedAs: String @cost(weight: "10")
}

"One event of a followed run: a step, a change of state, or the end of the stream."
type RunProgressEvent {
  runId: String! @cost(weight: "10")
  "This event's number; a skipped number means events were lost, so read the run again."
  sequence: Long! @cost(weight: "10")
  state: RunProgressState @cost(weight: "10")
  step: JunctionStep @cost(weight: "10")
  failure: String @cost(weight: "10")
  problem: SnapshotProblem @cost(weight: "10")
  "The id of the run that retries this failed one: follow that run next. The last event of the stream."
  retriedAs: String @cost(weight: "10")
}

"Where a followed run stands."
enum RunProgressState {
  "Queued, and not yet dispatched."
  QUEUED
  "Dispatched, and not yet running."
  PENDING
  "Running."
  IN_PROGRESS
  "Finished."
  COMPLETED
  "Ended with a failure."
  FAILED
  "Cancelled."
  CANCELLED
}

"A typed problem returned as DATA from a mutation (never a thrown error across the API boundary)."
type SnapshotProblem {
  "The code a client branches on, such as UnknownMachine or NoTransition."
  code: RefusalCode!
  "A human-readable explanation for logs or display. Its wording is not a contract; branch on Code."
  message: String!
}

enum SortEnumType {
  ASC
  DESC
}
